messages:
maggie.marketing: Morning — new launch blog draft live (v2). Quick pass needed: copy, legal, UTMs for CTAs, and webinar slot count. Link: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v2 :rocket:

sam.copy: reading now. Suggest compressing hero to one line + a 2-line kicker. Move customer quote up to lead with outcomes.

maggie.marketing: yes please. Also we need three CTAs mapped to tracking: hosted trial, dedicated trial, enterprise pilot.

devon.growth: proposed utm_content values: hosted_trial | dedicated_trial | enterprise_pilot. Lead tags: blog_mql and blog_enterprise.

nate.ops: CRM snippet I'll use:
```
utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may2026
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=hosted_trial|dedicated_trial|enterprise_pilot
```
I'll wire routing once UTMs confirmed.

elaine.legal: quick legal pass: remove comparative phrases (no "best"/"lowest"). Add security line: "Supports SOC2 and optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)." Approve after edits.

sam.copy: removing superlatives and adding KMS line. Also linking benchmark appendix instead of embedding chart.

alex.events: webinar: Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Recommend 12 demo slots + waitlist. I'll prepare calendar blurb and signup form after publish.

maggie.marketing: timeline: Sam final by EOD, Elaine signoff by 5pm, Devon confirm UTMs, Alex lock invites. Embargo planned 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo scheduled for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when you approve final copy.
